WITH
cast_ctype AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM comp_cast_type
    WHERE kind = 'cast'
),
complete_ctype AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM comp_cast_type
    WHERE kind LIKE '%complete%'
),
rating_info AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM info_type
    WHERE info = 'rating'
),
selected_keywords AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM keyword
    WHERE keyword IN ('superhero', 'marvel-comics', 'based-on-comic', 'tv-special', 'fight', 'violence', 'magnet', 'web', 'claw', 'laser')
),
movie_titles AS (
    SELECT t.id, t.title
    FROM title AS t
    JOIN kind_type AS kt
      ON kt.id = t.kind_id AND kt.kind = 'movie'
    WHERE t.production_year > 2000
),
rating_movie_info AS (
    SELECT mt.id AS title_id, mi.info
    FROM movie_info_idx AS mi
    JOIN movie_titles AS mt ON mt.id = mi.movie_id
    WHERE mi.info_type_id IN (SELECT id FROM rating_info)
),
keyword_movies AS (
    SELECT mt.id AS title_id
    FROM movie_keyword AS mk
    JOIN movie_titles AS mt ON mt.id = mk.movie_id
    WHERE mk.keyword_id IN (SELECT id FROM selected_keywords)
),
hero_characters AS (
    SELECT id, name
    FROM char_name
    WHERE name IS NOT NULL
      AND (name LIKE '%man%' OR name LIKE '%Man%')
),
base_rows AS (
    SELECT hc.name AS character_name,
           rmi.info AS rating,
           t.title AS complete_hero_movie
    FROM movie_titles AS t
    JOIN complete_cast AS cc
      ON cc.movie_id = t.id
    JOIN cast_ctype AS cct1
      ON cct1.id = cc.subject_id
    JOIN complete_ctype AS cct2
      ON cct2.id = cc.status_id
    JOIN rating_movie_info AS rmi
      ON rmi.title_id = t.id
    JOIN keyword_movies AS km
      ON km.title_id = t.id
    JOIN cast_info AS ci
      ON ci.movie_id = t.id
    JOIN hero_characters AS hc
      ON hc.id = ci.person_role_id
    JOIN name AS n
      ON n.id = ci.person_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT character_name
       FROM base_rows
      ORDER BY (character_name IS NULL) ASC, character_name ASC
      LIMIT 1) AS character_name,
    (SELECT rating
       FROM base_rows
      ORDER BY (rating IS NULL) ASC, rating ASC
      LIMIT 1) AS rating,
    (SELECT complete_hero_movie
       FROM base_rows
      ORDER BY (complete_hero_movie IS NULL) ASC, complete_hero_movie ASC
      LIMIT 1) AS complete_hero_movie
